channels_guild_shape.name: channels_guild_shape
channels_guild_shape.value: case when "channels"."type" in ('dm', 'group_dm') then "channels"."guild_id" is null and "channels"."parent_id" is null and "channels"."topic" is null and "channels"."position" = 0 and not "channels"."archived" else "channels"."guild_id" is not null and "channels"."owner_id" is null and "channels"."name" is not null end

channels_parent_shape.name: channels_parent_shape
channels_parent_shape.value: ("channels"."parent_id" is null or "channels"."parent_id" <> "channels"."id") and ("channels"."type" <> 'guild_category' or "channels"."parent_id" is null) and ("channels"."type" <> 'thread' or "channels"."parent_id" is not null)

channels_name_length.name: channels_name_length
channels_name_length.value: "channels"."name" is null or char_length("channels"."name") between 1 and 100

channels_dm_shape.name: channels_dm_shape
channels_dm_shape.value: "channels"."type" <> 'dm' or ("channels"."owner_id" is null and "channels"."name" is null)

guild_members_nickname_length.name: guild_members_nickname_length
guild_members_nickname_length.value: "guild_members"."nickname" is null or char_length("guild_members"."nickname") between 1 and 32

roles_icon_length.name: roles_icon_length
roles_icon_length.value: "roles"."icon" is null or octet_length("roles"."icon") between 1 and 64

media_uploads_purpose_scope.name: media_uploads_purpose_scope
media_uploads_purpose_scope.value: ("media_uploads"."purpose" = 'attachment' and "media_uploads"."channel_id" is not null and "media_uploads"."guild_id" is null) or ("media_uploads"."purpose" in ('guild_avatar', 'guild_banner', 'emote', 'sticker') and "media_uploads"."guild_id" is not null and "media_uploads"."channel_id" is null) or ("media_uploads"."purpose" in ('avatar', 'banner', 'badge_icon') and "media_uploads"."channel_id" is null and "media_uploads"."guild_id" is null)

relationship_pairs_request_valid.name: relationship_pairs_request_valid
relationship_pairs_request_valid.value: ("relationship_pairs"."state" = 'pending' and "relationship_pairs"."requested_by" is not null and "relationship_pairs"."requested_by" in ("relationship_pairs"."user_low", "relationship_pairs"."user_high")) or ("relationship_pairs"."state" <> 'pending' and "relationship_pairs"."requested_by" is null)
